items.title: Show HN: OpenKnowledge – open source AI-first alternative to Obsidian/Notion
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenKnowledge——Obsidian/Notion的开源AI优先替代品
items.summary: OpenKnowledge is a free, local, open-source WYSIWYG markdown editor available as a macOS app or a web UI plus CLI, with direct integrations for Claude, Codex, and other agents; it bundles MCPs, skills, and RAG aimed at LLM-wiki and 'AI second brain' workflows.

items.title: MKG-RAG-Bench: Benchmarking Retrieval in Multimodal Knowledge Graph-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: MKG-RAG-Bench：多模态知识图谱增强生成中的检索基准
items.summary: Presents a cross-domain benchmark for retrieval in multimodal knowledge-graph RAG, built from two multimodal knowledge graphs covering general and medical domains with aligned QA datasets; experiments show that retrieval quality strongly determines end-to-end generation.

items.title: Forget to Improve: On-Device LLM-Agent Continual Learning via Budget-Curated Memory
items.title_zh: 以遗忘求改进：端侧LLM智能体基于预算策展记忆的持续学习
items.summary: Proposes a single net-value-per-byte score that governs an on-device agent's experience-memory lifecycle, deciding what to keep under RAM and energy budgets, what to share over a thin uplink, and what to trust by provenance; on task-drift benchmarks and a Jetson testbed it cuts memory 2.7x and uplink 2.4x, drives injection success from 0.75 to zero, and improves accuracy on cases corrupted by poison or stale memory.

items.title: ChartWalker: Benchmarking the Cross-Chart RAG Task with Hierarchical Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: ChartWalker：以分层知识图谱评测跨图表RAG任务
items.summary: Introduces a framework that builds chart-specific hierarchical knowledge graphs and uses structure-aware sampling to synthesize semantically coherent multi-hop cross-chart questions; the resulting ChartWalker-Bench spans diverse domains and reveals significant gaps across major RAG paradigms, with an agentic baseline also released.

items.title: DeepSeek pivots to aggressive expansion with $7B funding and massive hiring
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 完成 70 亿美元融资并大规模招聘，转向激进扩张
items.summary: DeepSeek has raised a record $7B and plans to double every department while launching its Harness AI coding-agent team to rival Anthropic's Claude Code, reversing its prior 'no funding, no commercialization' stance.

items.title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
items.title_zh: AIR：多模态大语言模型中代码增强的自适应交错推理
items.summary: Trains multimodal LLMs for adaptive interleaved reasoning with code via reinforcement learning on code-augmented numerical tasks, using a two-stage cold-start pipeline, filtered RL data, and a group-constrained reward; performance improves by an average of 6.1 percentage points, with a 9.9-point gain on interleaved reasoning samples and tool-use success above 95%.

items.title: RASC+: Retrieval-Constrained LLM Adjudication for Clinical Value Set Authoring
items.title_zh: RASC+：面向临床值集编写的检索约束型LLM裁决
items.summary: A stage-wise pipeline pairs higher-recall candidate retrieval with a constrained LLM adjudicator for clinical value-set completion; on the RASC test split, pool recall rises from 0.553 to 0.730 and blinded GPT-5 adjudication lifts full-test macro F1 from 0.287 to 0.549 while keeping all returned codes inside an auditable candidate pool.

items.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
items.title_zh: 智能体AI漫游指南：从基础到系统
items.summary: Presents a practitioner's reference for building autonomous AI systems across the full stack, from LLM foundations and alignment to RAG and agentic RAG, memory systems, agent harness and loop design, graph-based orchestration, MCP and A2A coordination, evaluation, deployment, and regulation.

items.title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
items.title_zh: SHERLOC：面向代码修复智能体的结构化诊断定位
items.summary: A training-free framework that pairs a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery for fault localization; it reaches 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified, and injecting its locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields an average +5.95-point resolve-rate gain while cutting localization tokens by 36.7%.

items.title: How Do Tool-Augmented LLM Agents Perform on Real-World Energy Analytics Tasks?
items.title_zh: 工具增强型LLM智能体在真实能源分析任务中表现如何？
items.summary: Presents an empirical evaluation of tool-augmented LLM agents on 243 expert-curated energy-market problems across data retrieval, knowledge interpretation, and quantitative modeling; agents use live ISO APIs, regulatory docket search, tariff databases, optimization models, and RAG, and are scored on approach correctness, answer accuracy, attribute alignment, and source validity.

items.title: Narration-of-Thought: Inference-Time Scaffolding for Defeasible Ethical Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 思维叙述：大语言模型可废止伦理推理的推理时脚手架
items.summary: Introduces narration-of-thought, a system prompt that structures chain-of-thought into protagonist, stakeholders, two-step consequences, uncertainty, and commitment; across 100 DailyDilemmas scenarios and four generators it cuts stakeholder collapse from up to 31% to under 1% and uncertainty suppression from up to 72% to 1-24%, and a five-round debate variant raises consensus from 6% to 95%.

items.title: Beyond Surface Forms: A Comprehensive, Mechanism-Oriented Taxonomy of Indirect Linguistic Encoding for LLM-Based Coded Language Detection
items.title_zh: 超越表面形式：面向LLM编码语言检测的间接语言编码机制分类法
items.summary: Proposes a mechanism-oriented taxonomy of indirect linguistic encoding that abstracts away from communicative goals and categorizes how meaning is encoded and recovered; embedded in LLM prompts, it beats four existing taxonomies and a no-taxonomy baseline on 2,000 annotated TikTok and Bluesky posts, with document-level gains of +3.8 accuracy and +4.3 macro-F1 points for GPT-5.4, and also leads on 800 Chinese coded-language reviews.

items.title: When are likely answers right? On Sequence Probability and Correctness in LLMs
items.title_zh: 可能的答案何时正确？论LLM中的序列概率与正确性
items.summary: Quantifies when sequence probability aligns with correctness across decoding methods, hyperparameters, prompt-answer pairs, and repeated responses; higher sequence probability is often predictive of correctness within a fixed dataset, but this does not generally transfer to decoding decisions, and it is not a good indicator of correctness for responses to the same prompt.

items.title: Digitizing Coaching Intelligence: An Agentic Framework for Holistic Athlete Profiling using VLM and RAG
items.title_zh: 数字化教练智能：基于 VLM 与 RAG 的运动员整体画像智能体框架
items.summary: The paper presents an LLM-based hybrid agentic framework, orchestrated with LangGraph, that combines MediaPipe kinematic tracking with Llama-4-scout vision-language reasoning to profile athletes against Sports Authority of India assessment protocols. It introduces a 3x3 Smart Grid temporal chunking strategy reported to cut computational overhead by over 88%, an LLM-as-a-Judge self-correction loop, and a ChromaDB-backed RAG pipeline for natural-language semantic queries over athlete records.

items.title: LLawCo: Learning Laws of Cooperation for Modeling Embodied Multi-Agent Behavior
items.title_zh: LLawCo：学习协作法则以建模具身多智能体行为
items.summary: LLawCo lets embodied LLM agents reflect on past failures to extract misaligned behavioral patterns, derive high-level behavioral laws such as 'Talk when necessary' and 'Wait for partner', and incorporate them into their chains of thought via supervised fine-tuning. The authors also introduce the PARTNR-Dialog benchmark and report average success-rate gains of 4.5% on PARTNR-Dialog and 6.8% on TDW-MAT across four backbone LLMs over state-of-the-art open-source communicative agent frameworks.

items.title: Customized Generative AI Agent for Transportation Engineering Practice: A Development and Continued Pre-training Guideline
items.title_zh: 面向交通工程实践的定制生成式 AI 智能体：开发与持续预训练指南
items.summary: The study continued-pretrained six state-of-the-art LLMs through a unified LoRA framework on a curated corpus of U.S. transportation manuals, design guidelines and regulatory documents, monitoring training for convergence and stability. Evaluated with BLEU-4 and ROUGE, Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B showed the highest domain alignment and response quality, supporting a reproducible development framework for domain-specialized agents.

items.title: The Contagion Tensor: A Framework for Measuring Output-Distribution Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems -- and Auditing the Claims It Enables
items.title_zh: 传染张量：衡量多智能体 LLM 系统输出分布耦合的框架
items.summary: The Contagion Tensor is a measurement framework for quantifying how LLM output distributions couple across modalities, agents and time steps, yielding the Coupling Amplification Factor with bootstrap confidence intervals. In a 2x2x2 simulation plus real-API tests on DeepSeek-Chat and GPT-4o-mini, diverse personas drove convergence (CAF 0.88) while GPT-4o-mini with real vision showed a super-linear CAF of 1.72; five of 11 conditions were tested on real APIs and six remain unverified.

items.title: Anisotropy Decides Cosine vs. Rank Metrics for Text Embeddings
items.title_zh: 各向异性决定文本嵌入的余弦相似度与秩度量之争
items.summary: A study of nineteen parameter-free similarity metrics on nineteen encoders across seven datasets finds that cosine is best when an encoder spreads variance evenly, while rank-based and L1-type metrics beat cosine by a clear margin when variance concentrates in a few dominant directions, a gain of around 20% on average. The fraction of variance held by the single most dominant dimension predicts the benefit across all encoders with a rank correlation of 0.86 and linear correlation of 0.95; projecting out dominant directions restores cosine's advantage.

items.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
items.title_zh: UCOB：通过信用感知的在线策略双向自蒸馏学习利用与演化智能体技能
items.summary: UCOB treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two on-policy context views of the same model, compares their return-to-go at the same task and anchor state, and uses the higher-return view as a local teacher to internalize useful skills and correct misleading ones. It also guides skill-memory updates, utility-aware retrieval and reflection self-training; on ALFWorld, WebShop and Search-QA it outperforms skill-free RL, skill-memory and self-distillation baselines, with up to 23.5 and 18.0 point gains on ALFWorld and WebShop.

items.title: Critique of Agent Model
items.title_zh: 智能体模型批判
items.summary: Eric Xing and co-authors survey LLM agent architectures along goal, identity, decision-making, self-regulation, and learning, arguing that genuine agency must be internalized in the system rather than assembled through external scaffolding, and propose a Goal-Identity-Configurator architecture.

items.title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 当检索指标产生误导：测量长程工具使用智能体中的策略信号
items.summary: Tests exact-match retrieval recall as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model in tau-bench pre-action classification; although the governing rule is retrieved at rank 1 for only 7% of airline states, a 3B classifier scores 0.58 macro-F1 with retrieved assertions versus 0.60 with the gold rule, while random and no-assertion controls score 0.32 and 0.21.

items.title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench
items.title_zh: 基准饱和之后：CORE-Bench案例研究
items.summary: Argues that retiring a benchmark when accuracy saturates misses six other dimensions of agent performance, including construct validity, out-of-distribution generalization, efficiency, reliability, model-versus-scaffold importance, and human-agent collaboration; it releases CORE-Bench v1.1 plus an OOD suite, and a small randomized experiment finds human-agent collaboration roughly twice as fast.

items.title: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 后训练中被忽视的免费午餐：面向LLM智能体的进度优势
items.summary: Shows that RL post-training already yields a step-level scoring signal called progress advantage, the log-probability ratio between the RL-trained policy and its reference policy, which recovers the optimal advantage function; the signal is annotation-free and outperforms confidence baselines and dedicated reward models across test-time scaling, uncertainty quantification, and failure attribution on five benchmarks and four model families.

items.title: COCOLogic-V2: Identifying Logical Inconsistencies via Truly Hard-Negatives
items.title_zh: COCOLogic-V2：通过真正困难的负样本识别逻辑不一致
items.summary: COCOLogic-V2 is an object-centric dataset for visual inductive reasoning on real-world images that covers a broad subset of first-order logic, with samples split into positive variants plus near-boundary and far-from-boundary negatives for fine-grained diagnosis of model accountability. Evaluations show models separate positives from far-from-boundary samples well but fail on near-boundary ones, with perceptual noise and large rule-induced search spaces adding difficulty in few-shot settings.

items.title: For Coding Agents, the Repository Matters
items.title_zh: 对编程智能体而言，代码仓库才是关键
items.summary: Using multilevel models on agent pull requests from the AIDev dataset and human pull requests in the same public GitHub repositories, the study finds that about two-fifths of the variation in how long agent pull requests take to be resolved lies between repositories. Across 280 repositories the between-repository variance is 1.76 times as large for agent as for human pull requests, leading the author to argue that oversight and evaluation of coding agents should treat the repository, not only the agent, as a unit.

items.title: From Tool Connection to Execution Control: Benchmarking Security Invariants in MCP-Style Agent Runtimes
items.title_zh: 从工具连接到执行控制：MCP 风格智能体运行时安全不变量基准
items.summary: The paper formulates eight execution-layer invariants covering structured authority, resource resolution, principal binding, handle lifecycle and approval state, then compares an in-memory runtime (HCP) with an independent gateway ACL enforcing the same contract. Both block 18 modeled violations and complete 25 workflows, but live AgentDojo tests show strict grants also deny 40 non-attacker calls, and per-call grants cannot stop a secret passed as an ordinary argument to an authorized sink.

items.title: AURORA: Asymmetry and Update-Induced Rotation for Robust Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AURORA：基于不对称性与更新诱发旋转的鲁棒幻觉检测
items.summary: AURORA detects hallucinations by shifting from static hidden-state probes to weight-gradient dynamics, using two features: the skewness of cosine similarity between weight matrices and their gradient update directions, and a rotation ratio measuring how updates reorient singular-vector bases via SVD. It reports strong detection across four model families and four benchmark datasets, scales across model sizes, and transfers to out-of-domain tasks including mathematical reasoning and vision-language scenarios.

items.title: The Verbose Context Problem in Medical Records
items.title_zh: 医疗记录中的冗长上下文问题
items.summary: The paper defines the verbose context problem, where structured concepts have token-inefficient textual representations, and introduces PopMedQA, a benchmark of computational tasks over groups of longitudinal patient records built with the neopatient generation library. Ablations covering prompting strategies, prompt compression and agentic decomposition find that domain-independent methods fail to alleviate the problem, leaving room to exploit domain-specific structure for population-scale reasoning.

items.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
items.title_zh: Tencent/BrowserSkill：让智能体使用真实已登录浏览器
items.summary: Tencent's BrowserSkill is a CLI plus extension that lets AI agents use a real, logged-in browser without interrupting the user's work, aimed at any shell-capable agent.

items.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt
items.title_zh: NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt：面向研究的智能体优先强化学习框架
items.summary: NVIDIA NeMo's labs-molt is a roughly 9,000-line Python reinforcement learning framework for research, described as scalable, agentic-first, and HuggingFace-native.

items.title: tianma-if/edgeever
items.title_zh: tianma-if/edgeever：AI 原生知识库
items.summary: edgeever is a TypeScript AI-native knowledge base positioned as an Evernote/Obsidian alternative, offering instant sync and native MCP support. It can run free on Cloudflare or be self-hosted via Docker.

items.title: opendatalab/MinerU
items.title_zh: opendatalab/MinerU：将复杂文档转换为 LLM 就绪格式
items.summary: MinerU is a Python tool that transforms complex documents such as PDFs and Office files into LLM-ready Markdown or JSON for agentic workflows, preserving document structure including tables, formulas and images.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.title_zh: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp — 高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器
items.summary: codebase-memory-mcp is a high-performance code-intelligence MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph across 158 languages, with sub-millisecond queries, distributed as a single static binary.

items.title: Agent Seer: Synthesizing Scenarios from Specification Understanding
items.title_zh: Agent Seer：从规范理解合成评估场景
items.summary: Synthesizes evaluation scenarios for tool-using agents from a single MCP specification, generating graded scenarios, synthetic tool outputs, and multi-turn dialogues; across seven MCP specifications, parameter schema complexity was the strongest correlate of scenario quality.

items.title: HANCLIP: A Family of Hyperbolic Angular Negation Vision Language Models
items.title_zh: HANCLIP：双曲角度否定视觉语言模型系列
items.summary: Introduces a geometry-aware framework that combines a hyperbolic contrastive objective with an angular triplet loss to improve negation sensitivity while preserving a pretrained joint embedding space; trained on only 20,000 image-text quadruplets, it improves CLIP, LongCLIP, and SmartCLIP on NegBench while maintaining or improving zero-shot classification and retrieval.

items.title: JuZhou 1.0 Technical Report: The First Edge-Native Text-to-Image Foundation Model Trained Entirely on China-Developed AI Accelerators
items.title_zh: JuZhou 1.0技术报告：首个完全在中国自研AI加速器上训练的端侧原生文生图基础模型
items.summary: Presents an ultra-lightweight text-to-image foundation model for fully offline on-device use, built from a 0.385B-parameter denoising U-Net and a 1.90M-parameter distilled decoder, with Rectified Flow plus DMD2 distillation for 4-step sampling and Chinese semantic alignment from 9M image-text pairs; its 28-step base model scores 0.69 on GenEval, above SDXL (0.55) and SD3-Medium (0.62), with the full pipeline demonstrated on Android and the core generation branch on iOS.

items.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
items.title_zh: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL技术报告
items.summary: Describes a post-training pipeline that applies RLHF and on-policy distillation to the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model, using task-specific composite reward models fine-tuned from vision-language models for text-to-image and editing; the resulting model scores 57.84 on Qwen-Image-Bench, 2.61 above the base model, with Elo ratings of 1193 for text-to-image and 1349 for image editing.

items.title: Daybreak: Tools for securing every organization in the world
items.title_zh: Daybreak：保护全球每一家组织的工具
items.summary: OpenAI introduced new Daybreak tools, including Codex Security and GPT-5.5-Cyber, intended to help organizations find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities at scale.

items.title: How agents are transforming work
items.title_zh: 智能体如何改变工作
items.summary: An OpenAI research paper examines how AI agents are transforming work, reporting that they enable longer, more complex tasks and expand productivity across roles.
